title: Filtered colimits of cocartesian fibrations and of operads on total categories
statement: Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use the ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. For a small infinity category $B$, let $\operatorname{coCart}(B)$ be the infinity category of small cocartesian fibrations over $B$ and functors over $B$ preserving cocartesian arrows, as in [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening]. The total-category functor $\operatorname{coCart}(B)\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$, $(q:\mathcal E\to B)\mapsto\mathcal E$, preserves small filtered colimits: it carries every colimiting cocone of a small filtered diagram in $\operatorname{coCart}(B)$ to a colimiting cocone in $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$. The forgetful functor from ordinary nonsymmetric infinity operads to $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$, and the one from generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads, detect filtered colimits: a filtered cocone of operads is colimiting if and only if its underlying cocone of total infinity categories is colimiting. All assertions concern small filtered infinity categories and coherent diagrams, without restricting the transition functors to be fully faithful.
